title: The One #5 of 6 Epic Comics Marvel March 1986 Rick Veitch The One Wants You
conditionDescription: Cover clean with no creases or tears; spine and staples intact. Small wear on the back cover corners. See photos.
descriptionText:
The One #5 of 6 (March 1986), Epic Comics / Marvel - "The One Wants You" plus Puzz Fundles. Written and drawn by Rick Veitch, Rick Veitch cover. Baxter paper, $1.50 cover price.

Back cover: The Alien Legion poster ad.

See photos for condition. Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
